title: SHOWROOM SPEC CARDS
description: Vehicle previews now show grip class, upgrade limits, cockpit view, engine sample, and which cosmetics are included before the test drive starts.
consequence: The showroom stops mumbling through the glass.

title: PLAIN SKIN PREVIEW
description: Weapon skins now preview under normal mission lighting with no smoke, hero pose, rarity flare, or suspiciously flattering reload camera.
consequence: The mannequin turns on the lights.

title: CLASS BLESSING BUNDLE
description: The new player shop now recommends one class-themed bundle with a matching mount dye, starter weapon skin, and gold-trimmed path marker before the item details expand.
consequence: The first offer arrives already dressed for the class.

title: ARCHIVE BOOSTER FAMILIES
description: Card pack previews now group cards by set family, variant era, sleeve lineage, and seasonal archive tab before showing the exact card pool.
